verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a public Web API with a dedicated docs endpoint, and its pricing page cites audit-log API access, so a first-party, documented programmatic interface exists. The evidence is only a title-level mention, though. It never shows which product functions (sessions, devices, users, remote actions) can be driven through the API. Probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths and no llms.txt. missing for 10: evidence of API scope covering core product actions, machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, auth/usage documentation details, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
